title: ISO 8601-1:2019 Duration (Alternative Calendar Basic Format)
description: A duration in alternative basic format P[YYYYMMDD]T[HHMMSS] (§5.5.2.4)
$comment: Alternative-format durations are quantities, not calendar dates: each field is capped at its carry-over point (12 months, 30 days, 24 hours), years are unsigned, and expanded year forms do not apply
